chunks: From him, from Abū Jaʿfar, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Yazīd ibn Farqad al-Nahdī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who receives zakat: is the sadaqat al-fitrah due upon him? He said: No.

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat, the prescribed alms that may be received by the eligible poor
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man, meaning a person under discussion in the legal ruling
key_terms.صَدَقَةُ الْفِطْرَةِ: the alms of fiṭrah due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.لَا: no, indicating the negation of obligation in this case
key_terms.يَقْبَلُ: receives or accepts, referring here to taking zakat due to need

ai.seo_question: Is sadaqat al-fitrah obligatory on someone who receives zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith states that sadaqat al-fitrah is not obligatory upon a person who is eligible to receive zakat. It indicates a legal ruling that financial inability lifts this obligation from the poor and needy.
